en.p: For a point P moving on the line $2x+y=0$ and a point Q moving on the ellipse $2x^2+y^2=3$, consider all points X satisfying

whose $x$-coordinate and $y$-coordinate are both at least 0. The area of the region represented by these points is $\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here O is the origin, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
